analysis.summaryJa: このページは、andが単なる追加だけでなく、文脈によって動作の順序、継続、反復、そして『そうすれば』という結果への流れを作れることを扱う。一方soは原因から結果への関係を明示する。特に命令文＋and＋結果節のパターンを理解する。
grammarPoints: andで追加情報を等位に結ぶこと
andで自然な動作順序を表せること
命令文＋andで『そうすれば』の結果を表せること
反復表現and ... andで継続・繰り返しを強調できること
soで原因→結果を明示すること
andとsoの意味差を文脈から判断すること
visualEvidence: 命令→AND→結果の矢印がある
and andの反復ループが描かれている
cause→SO→consequenceの明示的な因果矢印がある
andは情報を前へ運びsoは結果を明示するという要点がある
commonTraps: andを常に単純追加と解釈する
命令文＋andを単なる並列と誤解する
soの前後の原因と結果を逆に読む
andの代わりにbecauseを入れて意味関係を逆転させる
反復のandを不要な接続詞だと考える
独立節の接続で不自然なカンマスプライスを作る

questions.prompt: Complete the checklist, ------- send it to the quality team before noon.

choices.A: because
choices.D: although

questions.translationJa: チェックリストを完成させ、それを正午までに品質チームへ送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの連続した指示をandで前へ進めています。

questions.prompt: The warehouse reached capacity, ------- incoming deliveries were redirected.

choices.A: so
choices.D: but

questions.translationJa: 倉庫が満杯になったため、到着予定の配送は別の場所へ回されました。
questions.explanationJa: 前半が原因、後半が結果なのでsoが適切です。

questions.prompt: Press the green button, ------- the system will restart automatically.

choices.A: because
choices.D: and

questions.translationJa: 緑のボタンを押してください。そうすればシステムが自動で再起動します。
questions.explanationJa: 命令文＋andで『そうすれば』という結果を表します。

questions.prompt: The customer called ------- called until someone finally answered.

choices.A: so
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: 顧客は何度も何度も電話し、ついに誰かが応答しました。
questions.explanationJa: called and calledは反復・継続を強調します。

questions.prompt: The technician opened the panel ------- found a loose cable inside.

choices.A: and
choices.D: although

questions.translationJa: 技術者はパネルを開け、中に緩んだケーブルを見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: 前半の動作に続いて後半の発見が起こる自然な順序なのでandです。

questions.prompt: Traffic was unusually heavy, ------- the sales team arrived twenty minutes late.

choices.A: and
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: 交通が非常に混んでいたため、営業チームは20分遅れて到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: 明確な原因→結果なのでsoです。

questions.prompt: Review the figures carefully, ------- you will catch most calculation errors before submission.

choices.A: so
choices.D: but

questions.translationJa: 数字を注意深く確認してください。そうすれば提出前にほとんどの計算ミスを見つけられます。
questions.explanationJa: 命令文を条件として結果が続くandの用法です。

questions.prompt: The printer jammed twice, ------- we moved the job to another machine.

choices.A: and
choices.D: so

questions.translationJa: プリンターが2回紙詰まりしたので、別の機械へ印刷ジョブを移しました。
questions.explanationJa: 前半を原因、後半を結果として明示するためsoです。

questions.prompt: The presenter paused, checked the screen, ------- continued with the next slide.

choices.A: and
choices.D: or

questions.translationJa: 発表者は一度止まり、画面を確認してから次のスライドへ進みました。
questions.explanationJa: 一連の動作を前へ進めるandが自然です。

questions.prompt: The storm warning was upgraded, ------- all outdoor activities were canceled.

choices.A: and only
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: 暴風警報が引き上げられたため、すべての屋外活動が中止されました。
questions.explanationJa: 原因から結果への関係を明示するためsoです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where and naturally shows sequence.

choices.A: The clerk checked the address although printed the label.
choices.B: The clerk checked the address so printed the label.
choices.C: The clerk checked the address because printed the label.
choices.D: The clerk checked the address and printed the label.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は住所を確認してからラベルを印刷しました。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの動作を自然な順序でつなぐandが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where so clearly marks a result.

choices.A: The loading dock was closed and the truck waited, with no result relation stated.
choices.B: The loading dock was closed, so the truck waited outside.
choices.C: The loading dock was closed because the truck waited outside, reversing the logic.
choices.D: The loading dock was closed although the truck waited outside as a result.

questions.translationJa: 荷積み場が閉まっていたので、トラックは外で待ちました。
questions.explanationJa: 閉鎖が原因、待機が結果なのでsoが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the meaning 'do this and then this result will follow.'

choices.A: Submit the request because approval will be faster.
choices.B: Submit the request but approval will be faster.
choices.C: Submit the request, and approval will be faster.
choices.D: Submit the request or approval will be faster in the same meaning.

questions.translationJa: 申請を提出してください。そうすれば承認が早くなります。
questions.explanationJa: 命令文＋and＋結果節の典型です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly emphasizes repeated effort.

choices.A: The customer asked and asked for an update.
choices.B: The customer asked because asked for an update.
choices.C: The customer asked or asked for an update.
choices.D: The customer asked so asked for an update.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は何度も何度も更新情報を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: asked and askedで反復を強調します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where and links two additive facts rather than a cause-result relation.

choices.A: The package includes installation although it includes two training sessions as simple addition.
choices.B: The package includes installation, so it includes two training sessions as simple addition.
choices.C: The package includes installation because it includes two training sessions as addition.
choices.D: The package includes installation, and it includes two training sessions.

questions.translationJa: そのパッケージには設置と2回の研修が含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの追加情報を等位に並べるためandです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where so correctly follows an explicit cause.

choices.A: The elevator was under maintenance and we used the stairs, necessarily meaning cause.
choices.B: The elevator was under maintenance because we used the stairs.
choices.C: The elevator was under maintenance, so we used the stairs.
choices.D: The elevator was under maintenance, but we used the stairs therefore.

questions.translationJa: エレベーターが点検中だったので、階段を使いました。
questions.explanationJa: 点検中が原因で階段使用が結果なのでsoです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where and conveys a natural event sequence.

choices.A: The assistant opened the parcel because noticed the damage.
choices.B: The assistant opened the parcel and noticed the damage.
choices.C: The assistant opened the parcel so noticed the damage without a subject.
choices.D: The assistant opened the parcel although noticed the damage.

questions.translationJa: アシスタントは荷物を開け、損傷に気づきました。
questions.explanationJa: 開封→発見という自然な順序をandでつないでいます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses imperative + and.

choices.A: Check the reservation because you'll avoid duplicate bookings.
choices.B: Check the reservation but you'll avoid duplicate bookings.
choices.C: Check the reservation or you'll avoid duplicate bookings with the same positive meaning.
choices.D: Check the reservation, and you'll avoid duplicate bookings.

questions.translationJa: 予約を確認してください。そうすれば重複予約を避けられます。
questions.explanationJa: 命令・助言の実行が後半の結果条件となるandです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly distinguishes addition from result.

choices.A: The office moved because its phone number also changed, as simple addition.
choices.B: The office moved, so its phone number also changed, even though no cause is intended.
choices.C: The office moved, and its phone number also changed.
choices.D: The office moved although its phone number also changed, as simple addition.

questions.translationJa: 事務所は移転し、電話番号も変更されました。
questions.explanationJa: ここでは二つの変更を追加情報として並べるためandが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that makes the causal result explicit.

choices.A: The temperature rose, so the alarm activated.
choices.B: The temperature rose and the alarm activated, which may only imply sequence.
choices.C: The temperature rose because the alarm activated.
choices.D: The temperature rose or the alarm activated as a certain result.

questions.translationJa: 温度が上がったため、警報が作動しました。
questions.explanationJa: 因果関係を明示したいのでsoが最適です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Open the link, and the registration page will appear."

choices.A: If you open the link, the registration page will appear.
choices.B: The registration page appears before you open the link.
choices.C: Opening the link and the page appearing are unrelated additions.
choices.D: You must choose between opening the link and seeing the page.

questions.translationJa: リンクを開けば、登録ページが表示されます。
questions.explanationJa: 命令文＋andは条件的に『そうすれば』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The roads were icy, so deliveries were delayed."

choices.A: Deliveries caused the roads to become icy.
choices.B: Deliveries were delayed despite clear roads.
choices.C: The roads and deliveries are alternative possibilities.
choices.D: The icy roads caused delivery delays.

questions.translationJa: 道路凍結が配送遅延の原因になりました。
questions.explanationJa: soは原因→結果を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The technician removed the cover and found a broken connector."

choices.A: The connector was found before the cover was removed.
choices.B: The technician chose between two actions.
choices.C: The sentence naturally presents removal followed by discovery.
choices.D: The broken connector caused the technician never to remove the cover.

questions.translationJa: 技術者はカバーを外し、壊れたコネクタを見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: andが自然な動作順序を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The supplier promised and promised, but nothing changed."

choices.A: The supplier made only one promise.
choices.B: The repeated use of promised emphasizes repeated promises.
choices.D: The supplier's promise immediately solved the issue.

questions.translationJa: 供給会社は何度も約束しましたが、何も変わりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: promised and promisedが反復を強調しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The customer signed the form and returned it to reception."

choices.A: The sentence presents two actions in a forward sequence.
choices.B: Returning the form caused the customer to sign it earlier.
choices.C: The customer selected only one of the two actions.
choices.D: The two actions necessarily happened on different days.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は用紙に署名し、受付へ返却しました。
questions.explanationJa: andが情報と動作を前へ運んでいます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The battery was empty, so the device would not start."

choices.A: The device caused the battery to empty.
choices.B: Battery level and startup are unrelated additions.
choices.C: The empty battery explains the device's failure to start.
choices.D: The device started despite the empty battery.

questions.translationJa: バッテリー切れが、装置が起動しなかった理由です。
questions.explanationJa: soが明確な原因→結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Follow the signs, and you'll reach the loading dock."

choices.A: The signs are an alternative to the loading dock.
choices.B: You reached the dock before following any signs.
choices.C: The loading dock causes the signs to appear.
choices.D: Following the signs is presented as the condition for reaching the dock.

questions.translationJa: 標識に従えば、荷積み場に着きます。
questions.explanationJa: 命令＋andで条件的な結果を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The alarm sounded, and everyone looked toward the exit."

choices.A: The sentence naturally moves from the alarm to the following reaction.
choices.C: Looking toward the exit caused the alarm.
choices.D: The alarm sounding is explicitly denied as happening first.

questions.translationJa: 警報が鳴り、全員が出口の方を見ました。
questions.explanationJa: andが出来事の流れを前へ進めています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The client changed the specification, so we revised the quotation."

choices.A: The revised quotation caused the specification change.
choices.B: The specification change led to the quotation revision.
choices.C: The two events are merely alternatives.
choices.D: No relationship between the events is indicated.

questions.translationJa: 仕様変更を受けて、見積もりを修正しました。
questions.explanationJa: soにより原因→結果が明示されています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Check the address, and the package should arrive correctly."

choices.A: Checking the address is unrelated to delivery.
choices.B: The package must arrive before the address is checked.
choices.C: Correctly checking the address supports the expected result of correct delivery.
choices.D: You must choose either checking the address or receiving the package.

questions.translationJa: 住所を確認すれば、荷物は正しく届くはずです。
questions.explanationJa: 命令＋andで実行後の期待される結果を示します。

questions.prompt: The conference room is on the second floor. Take the elevator, ------- turn right when the doors open.

choices.A: so
choices.D: although

questions.translationJa: 会議室は2階です。エレベーターに乗り、扉が開いたら右へ曲がってください。
questions.explanationJa: 連続した指示を前へ進めるandです。

questions.prompt: The booking system was unavailable, ------- staff recorded reservations manually.

choices.A: and
choices.D: so

questions.translationJa: 予約システムが使えなかったため、スタッフは予約を手作業で記録しました。
questions.explanationJa: システム停止が原因で手作業対応が結果なのでsoです。

questions.prompt: Save your changes, ------- the updated file will be available to the whole team.

choices.A: and
choices.D: or

questions.translationJa: 変更を保存してください。そうすれば更新済みファイルをチーム全員が利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: 命令文＋andで結果を示します。

questions.prompt: The queue grew ------- grew until additional staff opened another counter.

choices.A: so
choices.D: or

questions.translationJa: 列はどんどん長くなり、追加スタッフが別窓口を開けるまで続きました。
questions.explanationJa: grew and grewで継続的な増加を強調します。

questions.prompt: The assistant scanned the documents ------- uploaded them to the shared folder.

choices.A: although
choices.D: and

questions.translationJa: アシスタントは書類をスキャンし、共有フォルダへアップロードしました。
questions.explanationJa: 自然な作業順序をandでつないでいます。

questions.prompt: The flight was canceled, ------- the sales director joined the meeting online instead.

choices.A: and only
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: 便が欠航したため、営業部長は代わりにオンラインで会議へ参加しました。
questions.explanationJa: 欠航が原因、オンライン参加が結果なのでsoです。

questions.prompt: Read the instructions first, ------- you will avoid most setup mistakes.

choices.A: and
choices.D: but

questions.translationJa: まず説明書を読んでください。そうすれば設定ミスの多くを避けられます。
questions.explanationJa: 助言の実行が後半の結果につながる命令＋andです。

questions.prompt: The temperature sensor failed, ------- production was stopped for inspection.

choices.A: and
choices.D: so

questions.translationJa: 温度センサーが故障したため、点検のため生産が停止されました。
questions.explanationJa: 原因から結果への関係をsoが明示します。

questions.prompt: The representative greeted the visitors, checked their badges, ------- led them to the conference room.

choices.A: because
choices.D: or

questions.translationJa: 担当者は来訪者に挨拶し、入館証を確認して会議室へ案内しました。
questions.explanationJa: 一連の行動をandで前進させています。

questions.prompt: Demand rose sharply in July, ------- the company added a weekend shift in August.

choices.A: although
choices.D: or

questions.translationJa: 7月に需要が急増したため、会社は8月に週末シフトを追加しました。
questions.explanationJa: 需要増を原因、シフト追加を結果として明示するsoが適切です。
